# Switch off the TGP Finance diagnostic quiz in the fitness backend (B-QUIZ-OFF)

Owner 2026-10-01 15:25: the 40-point diagnostic quiz belongs to TGP Finance, so it is off in this fitness backend, with no table drops.

## Tier header
- **Tier:** T2
- **Why:** removes three unauthenticated public routes (`GET /diagnostic/questions`, `POST /diagnostic/submit`, `GET /diagnostic/:id`) and the AI roadmap call behind them from the running app. No auth, session, consent, payments or RLS logic changes; no schema or migration change.
- **T4 trigger scan:** none. No `.github/workflows/*`, `scripts/ci/*`, schema-parity baseline, branch-protection script, credentials, payments or RLS policy. No migration (`prisma/` untouched).
- **T3 trigger scan:** auth/PII. The removed routes took a lead's email + answers without auth; this PR only stops them from being mounted. Existing `diagnostic_submissions` rows stay covered by data export (`DataExportService`) and account deletion (`AccountDeletionService`), which read Prisma directly and are unchanged. No auth flow or PII handling code changes, so it stays T2.
- **Bounded T1:** n/a.
- **Builder-owner:** lane B-JOURNEY-2 (Claude Opus 5.5) for operator agent 112.
- **Acceptance evidence:** targeted jest below; CI at head (build-and-test runs tsc + full suites).
- **Promotion triggers:** any change that drops or migrates the diagnostic tables, touches data export / deletion of those rows, or re-mounts the module.

## What changed
- `src/app.module.ts`: `DiagnosticModule` is no longer imported, so its controller, `DiagnosticService` and `AiRoadmapService` are not instantiated and no `/diagnostic` route exists (404). A comment at the import site says why and names the guard spec.
- `src/diagnostic/**` code is kept (not mounted) so existing unit specs (`test/diagnostic.controller.spec.ts`, `test/diagnostic-prompt-doctrine.spec.ts`, `test/ai-egress/coach-ai-consent.spec.ts`) keep compiling; no table drops, no migration.
- Docs no longer present it as live: `docs/diagnostic.md` and `src/diagnostic/README.md` carry a "switched off" banner; `README.md` (module list + the two env rows), `docs/security/role-gating.md`, `src/throttler/README.md` and `.env.example` mark it not mounted / inert. ENV_RULES are unchanged (both names are still read by the unmounted code; `prod-switches.yml` mirrors their text).

## Not changed (on purpose)
- `DIAGNOSTIC_AI_ENABLED` / `DIAGNOSTIC_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR` stay registered (inert). The `diagnostic-submit` named throttler stays in `THROTTLER_LIMITS` (`test/rate-limit.spec.ts` pins it); under the C14 isolation rule a named throttler applies only to routes that opt in, and none is mounted.
- Admin transformation scorecard still reads existing `diagnosticSubmission` rows defensively (owner-only report).
- `prisma/seed-build-week.json` Day 1 still has a "Complete the 40-point diagnostic" task (Build Week catalog data). Flagged to the operator; not edited here.

## Tests
New `test/diagnostic-quiz-off.spec.ts` compiles and boots the real `AppModule` (same path as `module-graph.spec.ts` / `openapi-spec.spec.ts`), listens on an ephemeral loopback port and proves:
1. `DiagnosticModule` is not in AppModule's authored import graph and not in the live container;
2. no registered controller serves a `/diagnostic` path; `DiagnosticController` and `AiRoadmapService` are not instantiated;
3. `GET /diagnostic/questions`, `POST /diagnostic/submit`, `GET /diagnostic/<uuid>` answer 404 over HTTP, with a positive control (`GET /healthz` on the same server answers 200);
4. the OpenAPI document publishes no `/diagnostic` path.

## Builder evidence (head 9697c735)
- `heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand test/diagnostic-quiz-off.spec.ts`: PASS 7/7. With `test/diagnostic.controller.spec.ts`: 10/10 (unmounted code still unit-tested).
- Fails on main by construction: main's AppModule imports DiagnosticModule (test 1 and 2 fail; the three routes answer, not 404).
- `npx eslint test/diagnostic-quiz-off.spec.ts src/app.module.ts`: 0 problems. `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range`: no positive token change (the first push used a banned cast in the spec; fixed in 9697c735 by reading `ModulesContainer`).
- tsc: CI build-and-test (operator 12:40 offload rule).

## Fix round
| Finding | What changed | Commit | Test that proves it |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none yet) | | | |
